$comment: MODE = dark. Neutrals only. This is Confetti's dark look and the fallback for any theme that doesn't bring its own — a near-neutral GRAY ramp on a near-black content ground (#101012), with true black below it as the recessed mat, cool off-white text, and the brand red left as the one warm thing on the page. Light mode is warm cream paper; the two modes are deliberately different temperatures rather than one being a tinted copy of the other. How light `card` is drives almost everything else here: it is the lightest surface, so it sets the contrast floor, and the palest brand red is what caps it. Subtle accent tints deepen (X.700) so the light foreground reads on them; the hover shadow repoints to chalk, since a dark shadow on a dark surface reads as nothing. Emitted under [data-mode='dark'].

backdrop.comment: recessed mat — the deepest graphite, below page. True black now that page sits at #101012, which gives this role real depth to work with again.

status.$comment: STATUS roles — see the note in modes/light.json. Only `text` moves between modes: the rich green FILL carries its white label at 5.34:1 on any page, but the same green AS TEXT drops to 2.43:1 on the card surface, so it lifts to green.400 here.

subtle.comment: the tint end goes deep in dark, like the accent tints

danger.$comment: See the note in modes/light.json — danger is caution tape as a FILL and red as TEXT. Dark takes the deeper yellow step: the light one glares against a near-black page.

fill.comment: hazard yellow, deepened for dark — carries a black label at 9.93:1

on-fill.comment: black on the tape, the same pair as light

text.comment: danger AS TEXT — the palest red, and the same lift brand-as-text takes. It has to be the palest one: red.300 fails on Confetti's `card` (3.50:1) and on Adventure's #35492f and Neon's #2e1650 too, so no theme on this mode can afford the more saturated step.

stripe.comment: the hazard stripe on a danger control — full black on yellow, so the diagonal reads as tape rather than as texture

on-bold.comment: bold hues stay light in dark mode, so the deepest graphite reads on them

on-subtle.comment: subtle tints are deep in dark mode — needs the light foreground

button-lift.comment: button hover shadow — separate from card so a theme can drop or swap it
